coverage: System design site (partner of AlgoMonster) with about 41 problems, including 6 AI/LLM ones, a free primer, and pattern / technology / fundamentals / domain-knowledge pages. Newer solution pages share one numbered structure: problem, key concepts, requirements, estimation, API, data model, high-level design built up step by step, deep dives with Bad/Good/Great tabs, variants, transferable pattern, 30-second review, quiz, sources. Most have embedded simulators or calculators. Older pages (e.g. URL shortener) are plain text with collapsed sections. Solution and primer text was readable without login. A separate AI-interviewer practice mode per problem scores five stages; saved progress needs sign-in and the course is sold via /pricing.

refs.title: System design primer
refs.subject: system-design
refs.summary: Long primer: level expectations, core scaling problems, a single 'master template' architecture, and an interview method that turns verbs into use cases, nouns into entities and adjectives into constraints, worked on Twitter.

refs.title: Chat app (WhatsApp/Messenger) solution
refs.subject: system-design
refs.summary: Builds the design from one server to the full delivery path; deep dives on delivery and dedup, per-chat ordering, group fan-out and presence. Live estimation panel and a heartbeat/presence simulator.

refs.title: Chat app: AI mock interview practice
refs.subject: system-design
refs.summary: AI interviewer runs five short stages (scoping, high-level, end-to-end trace, scaling, capacity) in any order and scores each against a rubric; best score per stage saved when signed in.

refs.title: Distributed rate limiter solution
refs.subject: system-design
refs.summary: All five classic algorithms with an animated simulator (tune limit, window and arrival rate) and an over-allowance calculator; Bad/Good/Great deep dives on distributed counting.

refs.title: News feed solution
refs.subject: system-design
refs.summary: Push vs pull fan-out with a follower-threshold slider for the hybrid, celebrity hot-key handling via replicated cache and request coalescing, and a latency budget funnel.

refs.title: Distributed key-value store solution
refs.subject: system-design
refs.summary: Dynamo-style store: interactive R/W/N quorum widget, why quorum is not linearisable, LWW vs vector clocks vs CRDTs, hinted handoff for short outages and Merkle anti-entropy for drift.

refs.title: YouTube solution
refs.subject: system-design
refs.summary: Deep dives on the transcode pipeline, adaptive bitrate and CDN delivery, and egress cost with storage tiers; codec/ladder explorer, rebuffering simulator and egress calculator.

refs.title: Payment system solution
refs.subject: system-design
refs.summary: Idempotency and the 'in-doubt' outcome when the provider times out, double-entry ledger, sagas plus reconciliation; stepper that replays a capture timeout.

refs.title: Typeahead / autocomplete solution
refs.subject: system-design
refs.summary: Ranked trie with top-k per node built offline and swapped atomically, debouncing and hot-prefix caching for latency, skew-aware sharding, and a real-time trending layer for freshness.

refs.title: RAG system solution
refs.subject: system-design
refs.summary: Deep dives on the ANN index, retrieval quality (chunking, hybrid search, re-ranking, eval) and freshness; HNSW walk visualiser, filtered-search comparison and rank-fusion demo.
